title: How to stop Meta’s AI image generator from using your Instagram photos
slides: Your Instagram photos are training Meta’s AI. Want out?
Meta uses your public posts to improve its image generator.
The opt-out was buried—and doesn't apply retroactively.
You must submit a form in settings to block future use.
Check your privacy settings today and file the objection.
thread_text:
1. Your photos are training AI.

Meta already scraped your public Instagram images without asking. The opt-out only stops future use.

2. The opt-out is hidden.

You have to dig through settings to find a form. Most people will never know it exists.

3. No retroactive protection.

Everything posted before you opt out is already feeding Meta's image generator. You can't delete that data.

4. One form blocks future use.

Submit the objection in your privacy settings. It's a few clicks, but only works going forward.

5. File the objection today.

Open Instagram settings → Privacy → Data to block future scraping. Have you checked yours yet?

instagram.caption:
Meta already scraped your public Instagram photos—without asking—to train its AI image generator. 🚫

The opt-out button is hidden deep in settings. And even if you file it, everything you posted before stays in Meta’s model forever. 🔍 You can delete the data, but you can't delete what the AI already learned from it.

For anyone posting work or personal content: what you share now is future training fuel unless you act.

Have you filed the objection in your Instagram privacy settings yet? 📸
